tldr: 台股週五反彈583點、收43,675點，ASIC族群領軍，台積電漲10元至2,350元。
鴻海第三季EPS 5.51元創高，看好AI機櫃出貨2027年續增高雙位數。
美股週五因通膨數據偏熱收黑，那斯達克跌約0.9%、標普跌約0.4%，但三大指數全週收漲。

items.title_zh: 台股週五反彈583點 ASIC族群領軍
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks rally 583 points as ASIC names lead Friday rebound
items.summary_zh: 台股11月13日收盤上漲583.25點、漲幅1.35%，收43,675.12點，成交量約9,163億元；台積電終場尾盤雖遭大單賣壓，仍上漲10元至2,350元，聯發科等ASIC概念股領漲。此波反彈顯示在美股AI權值股震盪之際，台灣科技股買盤仍具韌性，為下週盤勢築底提供支撐。
items.summary_en: The TAIEX closed Friday, Nov 13 up 583.25 points, or 1.35%, at 43,675.12, with turnover of roughly NT$9,163 billion. TSMC added NT$10 to NT$2,350 despite a large late sell order, while MediaTek and other ASIC-related names led the advance. The rebound signals resilient risk appetite in Taiwan's tech-heavy market even as Wall Street's AI leaders wobbled.

items.title_zh: 漲勢收斂 台股上檔44,000點賣壓沉重
items.title_en: Index pares sharp early gains as resistance caps the TAIEX near 44,000
items.summary_zh: 台股早盤一度大漲近1,400點，但在44,000點上方遇賣壓，終場漲幅收斂至583點。此一「開高走低、尾盤守紅」型態顯示上檔套牢與獲利了結賣壓明顯，經歷震盪的一週後，指數短線恐須先行整理、量能續增後才有機會再攻高點。
items.summary_en: After surging nearly 1,400 points intraday, the TAIEX gave back much of the advance to finish up 583 points, as sellers emerged above the 44,000 level. The faded close highlights overhead resistance and profit-taking after a volatile week, suggesting the market may need to consolidate before attempting a fresh push higher.

items.title_zh: 鴻海Q3每股賺5.51元創高 AI伺服器成長引擎
items.title_en: Foxconn posts record third-quarter profit on AI server boom
items.summary_zh: 鴻海公布第三季每股稅後盈餘5.51元，優於第二季4.27元與去年同期4.15元；營收約3.02兆元、年增46%，雲端網路產品占比升至54%，成最大成長動能。公司預期第四季AI機櫃出貨將季增高雙位數，並看好2027年延續強勁，顯示AI基建需求推升代工龍頭營運續攀高峰。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) reported third-quarter EPS of NT$5.51, up from NT$4.27 in Q2 and NT$4.15 a year earlier, with revenue of about NT$3.02 trillion, up 46% year on year. Cloud and networking products rose to 54% of sales. Management guided for high double-digit sequential growth in AI rack shipments in the fourth quarter and into 2027.

items.title_zh: 鴻海ASIC AI伺服器出貨增1.5倍 動能快過GPU
items.title_en: Foxconn's ASIC AI servers outgrow GPU shipments
items.summary_zh: 鴻海表示第三季ASIC AI伺服器出貨量年增約1.5倍，高於GPU AI伺服器約七成的增幅，反映客製化晶片需求加速。公司提醒部分GPU與ASIC機櫃採寄售模式，認列營收增幅可能低於出貨增幅。此趨勢顯示AI硬體週期正由GPU向ASIC擴散，台廠在客製化AI方案的佈局有望帶來新成長曲線。
items.summary_en: Foxconn said third-quarter ASIC AI server shipments jumped about 1.5 times year on year, outpacing roughly 70% growth in GPU-based AI servers, as custom-silicon demand accelerates. The company cautioned that some GPU and ASIC racks ship on a consignment basis, so recognized revenue growth may lag unit shipments. The trend underscores a broadening AI hardware cycle extending beyond GPUs.
